### Grid Bota (all Metric)

```{r}
# Config
basic_config <- list(
  Level = "Family",
  Name = "Fabaceae",
  Type = "bota",
  Year = "2012",
  Radius = 10)

# No filters
grid_filters <- list()

# All metric
all_metrics <- c("Count","NCI","Basal_Area_m2","OTU","Shannon","H1")

# All plots
all_plots <- list()

for (m in all_metrics) {
  grid_config <- basic_config
  grid_config$Metric <- m
  
  # Grid Read
  grid <- grid_read(
    config = grid_config,
    filters = grid_filters
  )
  
  # Plot
  all_plots[[m]] <- plot_grid(grid)
  
}

Wrap <- wrap_plots(all_plots, ncol = 3) + 
  plot_annotation(
    title = paste0("Toutes les Metrics pour l'inventaire :  ", 
                   basic_config$Type, " / ", 
                   basic_config$Level, " / ", 
                   basic_config$Name, " / R = ", 
                   basic_config$Radius
                   )
    )


```

### Replace \< 2% families

```{r}

df_reduced <- df_combined

df_reduced$Result <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(df_reduced)), function(i) {
    df_reduced$Result[[i]] %>% percent_other("Clade", "Metric", 2)
  })


# Liste des indices correspondant aux différentes sources
source_indices <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7)
source_names <- c( "GH","GH", "ITS","ITS", "18S","18S", "Bota")

# Appliquer une fonction à chaque élément de la liste df_reduced$Result
df_list <- lapply(seq_along(source_indices), function(i) {
  # Extraire le dataframe correspondant
  df_temp <- df_reduced$Result[[source_indices[i]]]
  
  # Ajouter la colonne Source
  df_temp$Source <- source_names[i]
  
  return(df_temp)
})

# Sélectionner les éléments de df_list à combiner
df_plot_clust <- bind_rows(df_list[c(1, 3, 5, 7)])

# Créer le graphique avec ggplot2
clust <- ggplot(df_plot_clust, aes(x = Source, y = Metric, fill = Clade)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  labs(x = "Bota", y = "Proportion (%)", fill = "Clade") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1)) + # Affiche en pourcentage
  theme_minimal() +
  ggtitle("Proportion par Clade")



# Sélectionner les éléments de df_list à combiner
df_plot_rar <- bind_rows(df_list[c(2, 4, 6, 7)])

# Créer le graphique avec ggplot2
rar <- ggplot(df_plot_rar, aes(x = Source, y = Metric, fill = Clade)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  labs(x = "Bota", y = "Proportion (%)", fill = "Clade") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1)) + # Affiche en pourcentage
  theme_minimal() +
  ggtitle("Proportion par Clade")


# Plot function
ab_rel_plot(df_plot_rar)

```

## Rarefied

```{r}

# Levels
levels <- c("Species", "Genus", "Family")
# Rar

# Configurations
config_rar <- expand.grid(
  "g.Rar" = rar,
  "g.Marker" = c("GH","ITS","18S"),
  "b.Radius" = 10,
  "b.Year" = c(2012),
  "Metric_corr" = c("Count","NCI","T+","T-","MCC"),
  "Level" = levels,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Give common Names for each level
level_list <- setNames(
  lapply(levels, function(l) give_common_taxa(Rar = rar, Level = l)),
  levels
)

# Make correlation table
tab_rar <- make_cor_table_bota_genet(config_rar, level_list)

# View
```

# Tests Statistiques

## Test : Correlation \~ Metric_corr

```{r}
# ANOVA Test : Count / NCI
res_aov <- aov(Correlation ~ Metric_corr, data = tab_rar[tab_rar$Metric_corr %in% c("Count","NCI","MCC"),])
summary(res_aov)

#              Df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)  
# Metric_corr   2   0.14 0.07012    2.35 0.0963 .
# Residuals   555  16.56 0.02983                 
# ---
# Signif. codes:  0 ‘***’ 0.001 ‘**’ 0.01 ‘*’ 0.05 ‘.’ 0.1 ‘ ’ 1
# 729 observations effacées parce que manquantes

# Moyenne ajustée
library(emmeans)
emm <- emmeans(res_aov, pairwise ~ Metric_corr)
plot(emm)



```

## Test : Correlation \~ Level

```{r}
# ANOVA Test : Species / Genus / Family
res_aov <- aov(Correlation ~ Level, data = tab_rar[tab_rar$Metric_corr %in% c("Count","NCI","MCC"),])
summary(res_aov)

#              Df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)  
# Level         2  0.143 0.07154   2.399 0.0918 .
# Residuals   555 16.554 0.02983                 
# ---
# Signif. codes:  0 ‘***’ 0.001 ‘**’ 0.01 ‘*’ 0.05 ‘.’ 0.1 ‘ ’ 1
# 729 observations effacées parce que manquantes

# Moyenne ajustée
library(emmeans)
emm <- emmeans(res_aov, pairwise ~ Level)
plot(emm)

# Letters
library(multcompView)
tuk <- TukeyHSD(res_aov)
multcompLetters4(res_aov, tuk)

```

## Correlograme

```{r}
# Levels
levels <- c("Species", "Genus", "Family")
# Rar
rar <- TRUE 

# Configurations
config_rad <- expand.grid(
  "g.Rar" = rar,
  "g.Marker" = c("GH","ITS","18S"),
  "b.Radius" = seq(5,50,5),
  "b.Year" = c(2012),
  "Metric_corr" = c("Count"),
  "Level" = levels,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Give common Names for each level
level_list <- setNames(
  lapply(levels, function(l) give_common_taxa(Rar = rar, Level = l)),
  levels
)

# Make correlation table
tab_rad <- make_cor_table_bota_genet(config_rad, level_list)

# View
view(tab_rad)

# Save data
# save( tab_rad,
#   file = "~/Bureau/ADNe_Nourague_2026/ADNe_Nourague_2026_files/.tab_rad.RData")

load("~/Bureau/ADNe_Nourague_2026/ADNe_Nourague_2026_files/.tab_rad.RData",
  envir = .GlobalEnv)

# Plot
tab_rad$b.Radius <- as.factor(tab_rad$b.Radius)
tab_rad$g.Marker <- as.factor(tab_rad$g.Marker)
tab_rad$Level <- as.factor(tab_rad$Level)

p1 <- plot_correlogramme(tab_rad,"GH")
p2 <- plot_correlogramme(tab_rad,"ITS")
p3 <- plot_correlogramme(tab_rad,"18S")

(p1 | p2 | p3)

```
